url: Official Open Camera help pages (opencamera.org.uk) and in-app settings
description: Hand-verified capability inventory for Open Camera (net.sourceforge.opencamera), version 1.56.2.

features.name: Take a photo
features.description: Take a photo as documented for Open Camera.
actions: grant the camera and storage permissions
frame the shot on the preview
tap the shutter button (or press a volume key if configured)

features.name: Record a video
features.description: Record a video as documented for Open Camera.
actions: tap the photo/video mode toggle to switch to video
tap it again to stop; tap the pause control to pause and resume where supported

features.name: Switch between the front and rear cameras
features.description: Switch between the front and rear cameras as documented for Open Camera.
actions: Tap the camera-switch icon on the preview overlay
the preview changes to the other lens; on multi-camera devices, tap repeatedly to cycle through the available cameras

features.name: Zoom in and out
features.description: Zoom in and out as documented for Open Camera.
actions: Pinch on the preview with two fingers, or drag the on-screen zoom slider, or use the volume keys if they are configured for zoom

features.name: Focus by tapping
features.description: Focus by tapping as documented for Open Camera.
actions: Tap the point on the preview you want in focus
the focus box appears and the camera focuses there; enable "touch to capture" in Settings to also take the shot

features.name: Change the focus mode
features.description: Change the focus mode as documented for Open Camera.
actions: Tap the settings/popup icon on the preview
choose the mode (continuous picture, continuous video, auto, macro, infinity, fixed or manual)
for manual, drag the distance slider

features.name: Set the flash mode
features.description: Set the flash mode as documented for Open Camera.
actions: Tap the flash icon on the preview
choose Off, Auto, On, Torch or Red-eye reduction

features.name: Use the front screen flash for selfies
features.description: Use the front screen flash for selfies as documented for Open Camera.
actions: choose the front screen flash option; the screen flashes white when the shot is taken

features.name: Set exposure compensation
features.description: Set exposure compensation as documented for Open Camera.
actions: Tap the exposure (+/-) icon on the preview

features.name: Set the ISO and shutter speed manually
features.description: Set the ISO and shutter speed manually as documented for Open Camera.
actions: Open Settings and enable the Camera2 API
switch the ISO from Auto to a manual value
drag the shutter speed/exposure time slider

features.name: Set the white balance
features.description: Set the white balance as documented for Open Camera.
actions: choose a preset (auto, daylight, cloudy, incandescent, fluorescent, shade or twilight) or select manual and drag the colour temperature slider

features.name: Choose a scene mode
features.description: Choose a scene mode as documented for Open Camera.
actions: choose the mode (for example auto, portrait, landscape, night, sports, fireworks or snow)

features.name: Apply a colour effect
features.description: Apply a colour effect as documented for Open Camera.
actions: select the effect (for example mono, negative, sepia, solarise, posterise or aqua)

features.name: Set the photo resolution
features.description: Set the photo resolution as documented for Open Camera.
actions: select the megapixel/aspect option for the current camera

features.name: Set the image quality and format
features.description: Set the image quality and format as documented for Open Camera.
actions: set the JPEG quality slider and choose the image format (JPEG, WebP or PNG)

features.name: Capture RAW (DNG) files
features.description: Capture RAW (DNG) files as documented for Open Camera.
actions: choose whether to save RAW only or RAW plus JPEG

features.name: Use the self-timer
features.description: Use the self-timer as documented for Open Camera.
actions: choose the delay (for example 3, 5 or 10 seconds)
tap the shutter; the countdown runs before the shot is taken

features.name: Take a repeated series of photos (auto-repeat)
features.description: Take a repeated series of photos (auto-repeat) as documented for Open Camera.
actions: choose the number of photos and the interval between them

features.name: Take an HDR photo
features.description: Take an HDR photo as documented for Open Camera.
actions: Tap the photo mode selector in the popup settings
tap the shutter; the exposures are merged automatically

features.name: Take a DRO (dynamic range optimised) photo
features.description: Take a DRO (dynamic range optimised) photo as documented for Open Camera.
actions: tap the shutter; a single exposure is tone-mapped for a wider dynamic range

features.name: Take an exposure bracketing series
features.description: Take an exposure bracketing series as documented for Open Camera.
actions: set the number of images and the stops between them in Settings

features.name: Take a noise-reduction (low light) photo
features.description: Take a noise-reduction (low light) photo as documented for Open Camera.
actions: tap the shutter; several frames are combined

features.name: Capture a panorama
features.description: Capture a panorama as documented for Open Camera.
actions: pan slowly following the on-screen guide until enough frames are captured
the panorama is stitched and saved

features.name: Enable face detection
features.description: Enable face detection as documented for Open Camera.
actions: detected faces are outlined on the preview and used for focus and exposure

features.name: Enable auto-level (auto-stabilise)
features.description: Enable auto-level (auto-stabilise) as documented for Open Camera.
actions: enable the auto-level/auto-stabilise option; photos are rotated and cropped so the horizon is level

features.name: Show composition guides and crop guides
features.description: Show composition guides and crop guides as documented for Open Camera.
actions: tap the grid entry and choose the guide (for example rule of thirds, golden ratio, crosshair, or a 4:3/16:9 crop guide)

features.name: Show the histogram, zebra stripes and focus peaking
features.description: Show the histogram, zebra stripes and focus peaking as documented for Open Camera.
actions: enable the histogram, the zebra-stripe overexposure warning and the focus-peaking overlay as required

features.name: Show the angle, level, battery and free-memory indicators
features.description: Show the angle, level, battery and free-memory indicators as documented for Open Camera.
actions: toggle the individual on-screen indicators (angle, geo-direction, ISO, free memory, remaining time, battery, time)

features.name: Enable geotagging of photos and videos
features.description: Enable geotagging of photos and videos as documented for Open Camera.
actions: wait for the GPS fix indicator on the preview before shooting

features.name: Store the compass direction with photos
features.description: Store the compass direction with photos as documented for Open Camera.
actions: enable the geo-direction option; the bearing is written into the image metadata

features.name: Stamp the date, time and location on photos
features.description: Stamp the date, time and location on photos as documented for Open Camera.
actions: choose whether to include the date, time, location and a custom text
set the font size, colour and alignment

features.name: Add a custom text stamp
features.description: Add a custom text stamp as documented for Open Camera.
actions: type the text (for example a copyright line)

features.name: Set the video resolution and frame rate
features.description: Set the video resolution and frame rate as documented for Open Camera.
actions: tap the video resolution entry and choose the size
tap the frame rate entry and choose the fps

features.name: Record slow-motion or high-speed video
features.description: Record slow-motion or high-speed video as documented for Open Camera.
actions: select a high frame rate mode supported by the device

features.name: Record a time-lapse video
features.description: Record a time-lapse video as documented for Open Camera.

features.name: Set the video bitrate
features.description: Set the video bitrate as documented for Open Camera.
actions: choose a preset or enter a custom value

features.name: Limit the video duration or file size
features.description: Limit the video duration or file size as documented for Open Camera.
actions: set the maximum duration and the maximum file size
choose whether recording restarts automatically when the limit is reached

features.name: Enable video stabilisation
features.description: Enable video stabilisation as documented for Open Camera.
actions: enable the video stabilisation option (device support required)

features.name: Choose the audio source and control audio recording
features.description: Choose the audio source and control audio recording as documented for Open Camera.
actions: tap the audio source entry (for example default, microphone, camcorder, voice recognition or unprocessed)

features.name: Record GPS/time subtitles for videos
features.description: Record GPS/time subtitles for videos as documented for Open Camera.
actions: choose what is recorded (GPS coordinates and/or the timestamp); an .SRT file is written alongside the video

features.name: Use voice control to take a photo
features.description: Use voice control to take a photo as documented for Open Camera.
actions: tap the voice control icon on the preview to arm it
say the trigger word ("cheese") to take the shot

features.name: Use audio (noise) triggering
features.description: Use audio (noise) triggering as documented for Open Camera.
actions: choose the loud-noise mode and the sensitivity
make the noise to trigger the shutter

features.name: Use a Bluetooth LE remote control
features.description: Use a Bluetooth LE remote control as documented for Open Camera.
actions: scan for and pair the supported Bluetooth LE remote
use the remote button to trigger the shutter or start recording

features.name: Configure the volume key behaviour
features.description: Configure the volume key behaviour as documented for Open Camera.
actions: choose the action (take photo, zoom, change exposure, change focus, adjust volume or do nothing)

features.name: Enable touch-to-capture
features.description: Enable touch-to-capture as documented for Open Camera.
actions: enable "Touch to capture"; tapping anywhere on the preview then takes the photo

features.name: Lock the screen orientation
features.description: Lock the screen orientation as documented for Open Camera.

features.name: Use immersive (full screen) mode
features.description: Use immersive (full screen) mode as documented for Open Camera.
actions: choose which controls are hidden (for example hide the GUI or hide everything)

features.name: Set the photo and video save location
features.description: Set the photo and video save location as documented for Open Camera.
actions: choose the folder (or enable the Storage Access Framework and pick a tree with the system picker)

features.name: Use the Storage Access Framework for saving
features.description: Use the Storage Access Framework for saving as documented for Open Camera.
actions: select the destination folder with the Android picker

features.name: Open the last photo in the gallery
features.description: Open the last photo in the gallery as documented for Open Camera.
actions: Tap the thumbnail in the corner of the preview
the last captured photo or video opens in the gallery app

features.name: Pause the preview after taking a photo
features.description: Pause the preview after taking a photo as documented for Open Camera.
actions: enable "Pause after taking photo"; the captured image is shown with share, delete and info options before returning to the preview

features.name: Enable or disable the shutter sound
features.description: Enable or disable the shutter sound as documented for Open Camera.
actions: toggle the shutter sound option (where local regulations allow it)

features.name: Enable the Camera2 API
features.description: Enable the Camera2 API as documented for Open Camera.
actions: confirm the restart prompt; manual controls, RAW and high-speed modes become available on supported devices

features.name: Reset all settings to the defaults
features.description: Reset all settings to the defaults as documented for Open Camera.

features.name: Read the built-in help and about information
features.description: Read the built-in help and about information as documented for Open Camera.
actions: read the version and device capability report or open the online help pages. ## **Category: Additional applications**
